column3: “He will groan” is rendered “I will moan”; the LXX reads “I will moan.”
“More than the weeping of Jazer” is rendered “More than the weeping for Jazer.”
“Offers up a high place” is rendered “offers sacrifice on the high place.”
“Flutes it will groan” is rendered “wails like flutes”; “abundance it produced” follows a difficult Hebrew phrase.
“Turned a neck” is rendered “turned his back.”
“Turn back the captivity” is rendered “restore the fortunes.”
